description:
On the day she gave up on her dreams of becoming a fashion designer, Yoon Bidan stumbles into a strange world and finds herself working in a mysterious costume shop. It's Rudelli, a specialty wardrobe shop that creates clothes for monsters to live among humans. There, she meets many monsters and designs clothes for them.

Will she be able to realize her dream and become a successful designer?
